_comment: Pinned model metadata for Docker model preloading. sha256 is optional unless enforce_sha is true.
_format: model_id -> { revision: <git-commit-sha>, sha256: <hexdigest>, license: <spdx>, required: bool }

Vansh180/deepfake-audio-wav2vec2.notes: Primary audio deepfake detection model. REQUIRED: Pin revision to a specific Git SHA and provide sha256 for production.

clovaai/AASIST.notes: Opt-in fallback. Research-only license. REQUIRED: Pin revision to a specific Git SHA and provide sha256 if used.

pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1.notes: Requires HuggingFace user agreement. Set HF_TOKEN in .env.

openai/clip-vit-base-patch32.notes: ViT-B/32 CLIP — default OpenCLIP model (~150MB). Mapped from SIGLIP_MODEL_NAME=ViT-B-32.

openai/clip-vit-large-patch14.notes: ViT-L-14 CLIP — high-precision opt-in (~1.5GB). Set SIGLIP_MODEL_NAME=ViT-L-14.

microsoft/swinv2-tiny-patch4-window8-256.notes: Optional image classifier replacement for YOLO (Apache-2.0 path).

facebook/detr-resnet-50.notes: Permissive YOLO replacement for deployments requiring Apache-2.0 license.

resnet50_torchvision.notes: ResNet-50 torchvision weights DEFAULT. Leave sha256 null unless a verified full-file checksum is pinned.

laion/CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.notes: Higher-accuracy CLIP model for image-text forensic matching. Opt-in upgrade from ViT-B/32.

openai/whisper-base.notes: Whisper base model for audio transcription verification. Requires ~150MB.

microsoft/table-transformer-detection.notes: Table/document structure detection for PDF forensics.
